gaps.sentence: They settled the dispute after a long ___ (ARGUE).
The coach criticised the team's lack of ___ (DISCIPLINE).
gaps.explanation: 'Lack of discipline' — the noun is required after 'lack of'.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The committee's ___ (DECIDE) was announced this morning.
